prompts.furniture:
Original Japanese top-down pixel RPG asset visually inspired by Pokemon FireRed's overworld. Orthographic three-quarter TOP-DOWN RPG angle, front facing directly down to player, no isometric diamond or perspective convergence. Chunky deliberate pixels, crisp edges, restrained 24-color palette, dark colored outlines, sun from upper left, simple 3-shade clusters. Transparent background, no floor, no shadow beyond footprint, no text or logos. Readable when scaled down into a 16px-grid game. Match the attached reference sprites exactly in palette, outline and pixel density.
original design, not resembling any Nintendo/Game Freak/Pokémon asset. Match the palette, outline weight, pixel density and three-quarter top-down angle of the attached reference sprites exactly. First reference interior sheet is the primary runtime style; station and shop are style references only. Generate ONE furniture sheet 4 columns × 2 rows, no gutters, no labels. Each cell exactly 16x16 logical pixels enlarged, output 1024x512 if possible. Extremely chunky pixel art, one pixel outline, NOT detailed painted objects. Row 1: stairs going UP toward back wall, warm wood steps rising to pale landing at top with side railing; stairs going DOWN into dark opening at top with descending treads and dark walnut rim; wooden bed HEAD half with cream pillow and top of muted blue blanket; bed FOOT half with same blue blanket and wood footboard. The bed halves must stack vertically without seam (head bottom joins foot top), same width 12/16, centered. Row 2: small wooden writing DESK with pale paper; matching wooden DESK CHAIR; WARDROBE TOP half with cornice and upper double doors; WARDROBE BOTTOM half with continuing double doors, brass handles and feet. Wardrobe halves must stack seamlessly, 14/16 width centered. Transparent background around objects. Each cell uses almost full area. Walnut brown, ochre wood, cream, desaturated slate blue. Limit detail to true 16px shapes.

notes: Two themed Image Gen 2 sheets, each edited once. Square crops and nearest-neighbour reduction, hard alpha, exact existing interior palette. Rug edges composite generated one-pixel binding strips over existing RUG index 29 to retain its texture. Mock corners combine the corresponding horizontal and vertical strips. No game code changes.
